title: Compact Model Connections · v0.10.12
changes: Settings has a compact, fixed header with Experience / APIs / Users navigation and independently scrolling content
Admin APIs display one row per provider with encrypted server-key Save, unified read-only Test and Private/Shared access switch
Meta Muse/SAM, Aholo, Meshy and ElevenLabs appear first; other stored credentials remain accessible in a collapsed section
Removed RAM key storage, debug usage dump and oversized desktop 3D-provider panel from Settings
The XR CONFIG panel now chooses Aholo or Meshy 3D and displays whether the selected key is available to this profile
Existing vault keys, access scopes, user accounts and saved library data are preserved
